faq.q: Can you buy the PUDU D9?
faq.a: Not with a public price. PUDU said in December 2024 that D9 would open for pre-sale soon, and it now asks buyers to contact sales or request a demo.

faq.q: How much does the PUDU D9 cost?
faq.a: PUDU has not published a price. Resellers quote it on request.

faq.q: Do all advertised D9 features ship?
faq.a: PUDU warns that some example features in its promotional material are not yet available to customers and that functions depend on the sales contract.
